Brown_Spot shows discrete brown lesions — completely different from the test image.

- Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv reference: nearly identical — numerous small streaks, light/dark green mosaic
- Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus reference: more diffuse large yellow patches, not small streaks
- Yellow_Leaf and Brown_Spot: clearly different (necrosis/spots)

The test image matches Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv precisely — small interveinal streaks of 3-40mm as described in the knowledge base, not the large mosaic patches of SCMV.
